notes: Prices: copper per unit (100 copper = 1 silver, 10000 = 1 gold); quantity = units listed; null = not listed that hour. Percentiles are quantity-weighted. Flows are units per UTC day, summed over the hours in flow_hours (24 = a full day). sold_est = partial + early_cheap - relist: a low estimate, because a listing bought while it showed SHORT/MEDIUM time left counts as gone_short_medium (expired?), and every 2-hour listing shows MEDIUM from the start (#69). gone_short_medium is the upper margin.
